note: LLM-judged and not deterministic: a fresh vision-judge agent looked at each screenshot and said whether the layout fits the width and is legible. Another run can judge differently. check-vision.mjs verifies that the report is complete, that the screenshots on disk are the ones judged and that the frontend source has not changed since; it cannot verify that the judge ran.
